decisions.reason: As a direct extension of the core coolant-management portfolio, it fits the firm's strategy for modular process-media solutions and should remain on the market.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge strengthens the established filtration and coolant-treatment business, so keeping it supports customer value, service revenues and the firm's innovation profile.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is more adjacent than core, but it still complements the firm's material-flow and production-support offering and is worth retaining unless demand clearly disappoints.

The hinged belt chip conveyor remains a sensible adjacent product for a broad industrial automation and conveying portfolio, though portfolio pruning in this area makes its withdrawal risk somewhat higher than the core coolant products.
